ground_truth.unit: change in the cabinet replacement rate (share of ministers, 0-1)
ground_truth.location: Table A1 (Tables for Figure 2), column Base Model, Failed coup attempt
ground_truth.context: Table A1 ("Failed coup attempts. Country fixed effects: Country-level results"), Base Model column; plotted in the left panel of Figure 2. Time-series cross-sectional OLS of the year-to-year cabinet replacement rate (one minus the cabinet-size-adjusted retention rate of ministers, from WhoGov, July to July) on a failed coup attempt indicator (Powell and Thyne data; a failed coup before 1 July counts in that year, one after 1 July in the following year), with logged GDP per capita and logged population (Penn World Table 9.0) lagged one year, country fixed effects and year fixed effects.  Sample: country-years of independent countries with a lagged Boix-Miller- Rosato democracy score of 0, 115 autocracies, 1967-2016.  Standard errors clustered by country.

i4r.notes: Blanket verdict (perfect reproduction).  R re-coding rows with o_coeff 0.10 (Table A1 Base or Purges MAs, which share the rounded value): 0.102 (0.031) and 0.129 (0.031).  Stata log: 0.0985 (0.0327).

ground_truth.context: Table K1, column H2a: Experience; Figure 3 left panel.  Linear probability model of whether a cabinet member is purged (absent from the cabinet the following year; reshuffles within the cabinet are not purges) on a failed coup attempt indicator, experience-group dummies (2-3, 4-6, over 6 years in cabinet; reference under 2 years), their interactions with the failed coup indicator, lagged logged GDP per capita and population, country and year fixed effects. The failed coup coefficient is the effect for ministers with under two years of experience.

cell.label: claude-code
deviations_manifest: Individual-level models: the provided pop_pwt_ln_lag column is an exact copy of gdp_cap_pwt_ln_lag (verified in the final script), so it was collinear and dropped in attempt-4. The final script rebuilds lagged ln population as the year-1 value of pop_pwt_ln within country from the same file, as the paper's method specifies. This was found from a data diagnostic (attempt-5), not by comparing with any reported value.
Affiliation model: party_group 'independent' is treated as 'no party affiliation'; 'unknown' and missing party_group are excluded (reference: other_party).

Experience model excludes the leader and importance tier 0.5 (junior minister or other low-ranking post); rows with missing importance are kept. Importance model keeps tiers 4 (reference), 3, 2, 1, 0.5 and drops tier 0 and missing values. Responsibility model drops rows with missing minister_type.

Country level: autocracy = lagged Boix-Miller-Rosato democracy1 == 0 (lag built by country and year-1 match), years 1967-2016; controls lagged one year the same way. In the leader-FE Main model the lagged monarchy dummy is not fully collinear with leader FE under this lag construction, so it stays in the model (the paper says it drops).
deviations_stdout: individual-level lagged ln population rebuilt from pop_pwt_ln (provided pop_pwt_ln_lag duplicates GDP lag)
cell.notes: Independent blind reproduction from the paper text only; no author scripts, logs, .tex or images were opened. Country level (Tables A1/A2): fixest OLS of replacement_rateadj_minister on coupattempt_whogov (failed coup attempt already recoded July-to-July in the data), with lagged ln GDP/cap and ln pop (Base), plus lagged monarchy/military/party dummies (Main), and country or leader (leader_cab_id) FE plus year FE; SEs clustered by country. N: 3743/3703 (country FE), 3626/3590 (leader FE). Individual level (Tables K1/K2): LPM of purged_y1 on the failed coup indicator (coupattempt_presentyear), category dummies and their interactions with it, lagged ln GDP/cap and ln pop, and a cubic in experience (not in the experience model); country and year FE; SEs clustered by country. Sample: lagged BMR democracy == 0, 1967-2016, leader excluded, giving 95,344 minister-years before the model-specific restrictions. attempt-1, attempt-2 and attempt-5 were exploratory (no RESULT lines). attempt-3 crashed because update() does not handle fixest's | syntax. attempt-4 printed RESULTs, but stderr showed the population lag dropped as collinear; that led to the attempt-5 diagnostic and the data fix in the final run. The fix changes only the individual-level coefficients, and only slightly.
